scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle:unsigned: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease -PallowUnsignedRelease
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:archive: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath ios/output/OliveRemote-1.0.0.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates archive
